data.one_liner: Create customizable draggable bottom menus inspired by popular social media platforms.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to create custom draggable menus, expandable via levels, with scrollable support, fast-drag gestures, and multiple built-in UI templates.
use_when: You need a bottom sheet or menu that users can drag, expand, or minimize.
You want social-media-style drawers (Instagram, Snapchat, YouTube).
avoid_when: You only need standard Flutter material bottom sheets without complex draggable thresholds.
strengths: Fully customizable UI and levels for expandable behavior
Supports scrollable widgets seamlessly using ScrollableManager
Includes pre-built UI options and status/value listeners
weaknesses: Requires specific wrapping with ScrollableManager for complex lists
